meta.name: social-media-carousel
meta.description: Multi-slide carousel design for Instagram, LinkedIn, and Twitter/X with layout rules and hooks. Covers slide structure, text hierarchy, swipe psychology, and platform-specific specs. Use for: carousel posts, Instagram carousels, LinkedIn carousels, slide posts, educational content. Triggers: carousel, instagram carousel, linkedin carousel, slide post, carousel design, swipe post, multi-image post, carousel template, educational carousel, carousel content, instagram slides, linkedin slides

copy.tagline: 设计多页轮播图用于社交媒体发帖
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为Instagram、LinkedIn等平台制作吸引人的轮播图帖子。
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-slide carousels for social media posts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create engaging carousel posts for Instagram, LinkedIn, and other platforms.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的要求，生成适用于 Instagram、LinkedIn、Twitter/X 等平台的轮播图设计，包括每张幻灯片的 HTML 代码，并遵循布局规则和文案技巧。
howto.when: 当你提到“轮播图”、“Instagram 轮播”、“LinkedIn 轮播”、“幻灯片帖子”等关键词，或要求设计多图轮播内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个7页的Instagram轮播图，主题是5个CSS技巧。
say.note: Claude 会生成每页的 HTML 代码，并遵循7页框架。

say.text: 为LinkedIn做一个教育类轮播，第一页用大胆声明作为钩子。
say.note: Claude 会生成钩子页的 HTML，并给出后续内容建议。

say.text: 生成一个Twitter/X轮播，最多4页，尺寸1080x1080。
say.note: Claude 会按平台规格生成对应幻灯片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate carousel slide designs for Instagram, LinkedIn, and Twitter/X, including HTML code for each slide, following layout rules and copywriting hooks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "carousel", "Instagram carousel", "LinkedIn carousel", "slide post", or ask to design multi-slide carousel content.

say_en.text: Design a 7-slide Instagram carousel about 5 CSS tricks.
say_en.note: Claude will generate HTML for each slide following the 7-slide framework.

say_en.text: Create an educational carousel for LinkedIn, first slide with a bold claim hook.
Generate a Twitter/X carousel with up to 4 slides, 1080x1080 size.
say_en.note: Claude will generate slides according to platform specs.
